\section{Method}\label{sec:method}
The loss combines two terms:
\begin{align}
  \mathcal{L} &= \mathcal{L}_{\text{task}} + \lambda \norm{W}_2^2 \label{eq:loss}\\
  \lambda &= 10^{-4}
\end{align}
Equation~\eqref{eq:loss} is minimised with Adam. The scoring function is:
